@@U01708@@
But that’s not fair!

@@U01710@@
And even if she gets him,
it'll be no picnic for her.
The boys'll rip off her bridal garland,
and we'll strew straw at her
door for the shame of her.

@@U01711@@
(Exit.)

@@U01713@@
(Walking home.)

@@U01714@@
Time was Id rail with the best of them
about some poor girl who went wrong.
There were never words enough for the sins of others.
They seemed so black,
and I made them even blacker;
but even then it wasn’t black enough for me.
I'd bless myself then and feel so proud—
and now I’m just as bad as them.
And yet,
everything that drove me to it—
O God! How good it was,
how good, how sweet!

@@U01716@@
An image of the Mater Dolorosa（痛苦圣母） set in the niche of a wall with pots
of flowers in front of it. 格蕾琴 puts fresh flowers into them.

@@U01718@@
Mother of Sorrows,
behold me in my distress!
Your heart pierced by the sword
knows unending pain
as you look on your Son dying.
translation:
@@U01708@@
但这不公平！

@@U01710@@
即使她得到了他，
这对她来说可不是什么轻松的事。
男孩们会扯掉她的新娘花环
我们会在她身上撒稻草
门让她蒙羞。

@@U01711@@
（退出。）

@@U01713@@
（步行回家。）

@@U01714@@
我和他们中最好的人一起度过了时光
关于一些犯了错误的可怜女孩。
对于别人的罪孽，言语永远都不够。
他们看上去那么黑，
我把它们弄得更黑；
但即便如此，它对我来说还不够黑。
那时我会祝福自己并感到无比自豪——
现在我和他们一样糟糕。
然而，
驱使我这么做的一切——
上帝啊！本来多好啊
多么美好，多么甜蜜！

@@U01716@@
墙上壁龛中的痛苦圣母像，上面有盆子
前面有鲜花。 格蕾琴将鲜花放入其中。

@@U01718@@
悲伤之母，
看我在痛苦中！
你的心被剑刺穿
知道无尽的痛苦
当你看着你的儿子死去时。
